title: US court flags contradictions in DOJ bid to drop case against Adani, seeks US Attorney’s sworn account
description: A United States federal court has flagged contradictions in the Justice Department’s account of its decision to seek the dismissal of criminal charges against billionaire Gautam Adani and seven others in a $250 million bribery case.In light of the same, Judge Nicholas G Garaufis of the Eastern District of New York directed US Attorney Joseph Nocella Jr to submit a sworn statement clarifying his role in the decision and disclosing whether the government has any additional grounds for seeking dism
